entities.name: Coronation of Urza
entities.description: Ceremony in which Urza was made Lord High Protector and Tawnos Master Scholar of the Combined Kingdoms.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Appointed Lord High Protector of the Combined Kingdoms; received a miter lined with powerstones.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Appointed Master Scholar of the Combined Kingdoms.

entities.name: Combined Kingdoms
entities.description: Union of Argive and Korlis, later joined by Yotia as a vassal state.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Attended the ceremonies with her son Harbin.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: Senior student who attended the ceremonies.

entities.name: Rendall
entities.description: Senior student who attended the ceremonies.

entities.name: Miter
entities.description: Elaborate miter given to Urza, an artifact lined with small powerstones.

entities.name: Liberation of Yotia
entities.description: Event after which Yotia became a vassal state of the Combined Kingdoms.

events.summary: Following the unification of Argive and Korlis, Urza is appointed Lord High Protector and Tawnos Master Scholar.
events.quote: Urza was appointed as the kingdoms' Lord High Protector

events.summary: Urza receives an elaborate miter, which he later shows Tawnos is an artifact lined with small powerstones.
events.quote: Urza later showed Tawnos that the miter was an artifact lined with numerous small powerstones

events.summary: After the Liberation of Yotia, Yotia is added to the Combined Kingdoms as a vassal state.
events.quote: Yotia was added to the Combined Kingdoms as a vassal state

relations.quote: Urza was appointed as the kingdoms' Lord High Protector

relations.note: Appointed Master Scholar at the same ceremony.
